item.text: The core cases line up so far. I’m running a broader differential batch now, including the parser edge cases I used during reconnaissance, so I can catch mismatches in one pass instead of whack-a-mole patching.

item.command:
/bin/bash -c "cat <<'EOF' >/tmp/test18_diff.sh
#"'!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
exe=/workspace/dataset/test18_executable
node_cmd=(node /output/test18.mjs)
run_case() {
  local label="$1"
  shift
  local py_out js_out py_code js_code
  set +e
  py_out=$($exe "$@" 2>&1)
  py_code=$?
  js_out=$("${node_cmd[@]}" "$@" 2>&1)
  js_code=$?
  set -e
  if [[ "$py_code" != "$js_code" || "$py_out" != "$js_out" ]]; then
    echo "MISMATCH: $label"
    echo "ARGS: $*"
    echo "PY($py_code):"
    printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$py_out"
    echo "JS($js_code):"
    printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$js_out"
    return 1
  fi
  return 0
}

run_case help --help
run_case help_abbrev --he
run_case missing
run_case missing_j --a 1 --b 2 --c 3 --d 4 --e 5 --f 6 --g 7 --h 8 --i 9
run_case unknown_complete --a 1 --b 2 --c 3 --d 4 --e 5 --f 6 --g 7 --h 8 --i 9 --j 10 --z 11
